tips_en: Start with HarnessDev, which tackles the meta-level question of whether LLMs can build and improve their own agent infrastructure—a foundational capability that the other papers build upon. It pairs naturally with Terminal-Universe, as both explore how agents can be made more capable through better harnesses and training environments, respectively. LLaDA-Image stands apart as a multimodal generative work, best read afterward for a contrast in application domains.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 HarnessDev，它探讨的是 LLM 能否自主构建并改进智能体基础设施这一基础性问题，这也是其他两篇论文展开研究的前提。它与 Terminal-Universe 紧密相关，二者分别从工具框架和训练环境两个角度探索如何提升智能体能力。LLaDA-Image 属于多模态生成方向，建议最后阅读，以便与应用类研究形成对照。
